title: 上部 凡尘问道 第23章 王坤反追杀与逃亡上部 凡尘问道 第24章 救晚晴公开破法
content_zh:
第1节藏书阁围堵，禁制巧反击
凌无妄刚冲出**区后门，身后就传来重物倒地的声响。回头望去，柳砚已被数名天道卫按在地上，嘴角溢着鲜血，却仍嘶吼着“快走！别管我！”
“柳师兄！”凌无妄攥紧拳头，刚想回身救援，就被一道凌厉的灵力锁定。王坤带着十余名内门弟子从拐角冲出，为首的他左臂缠着绷带，正是之前筛选赛被灵气反噬的旧伤，眼神怨毒如蛇“凌无妄，跑啊！我看你今天往哪跑！”
【检测到核心威胁王坤（筑基中期），内门弟子12人（引气后期至筑基初期）。当前场景藏书阁三层回廊，环境含36处原初禁制节点。规则之眼解析效率90%】
藏书阁三层堆满古籍，书架高达三丈，形成纵横交错的回廊。王坤挥手示意“堵住所有出口！他刚吸收原初灵气，灵力尚未稳固，今天务必拿下他，夺取玉佩！”
内门弟子迅速分散，结成包围圈，手中长剑亮起闭源符文，灵气波动让空气都变得粘稠。凌无妄背靠书架，规则之眼快速扫描四周，发现回廊立柱上刻着细微的原初符文——这是上古时期留下的防护禁制，只是被墨规子的闭源规则压制，陷入休眠。
“想拿我？先过这关！”凌无妄不退反进，左脚猛地踹向右侧书架。书架轰然倒塌，古籍散落一地，正好挡住两名内门弟子的去路。同时他指尖凝聚一缕原初灵气，精准点向最近一根立柱的符文节点。
“雕虫小技！”王坤冷笑，挥剑斩出一道灵力匹练，劈向倒塌的书架。但就在灵力接触书架的瞬间，立柱上的原初符文突然亮起金色光芒，一道透明屏障凭空出现，将灵力匹练反弹回去。
“啊！”两名内门弟子躲闪不及，被反弹的灵力击中，当场倒飞出去，口吐鲜血。
王坤脸色骤变“原初禁制？你怎么能激活它们？”
凌无妄没有回答，脚下不停，接连踹倒三座书架，同时激活三处禁制节点。透明屏障此起彼伏，将内门弟子的包围圈撕开内门弟子的包围圈撕开一道缺口。他趁机穿梭在书架之间，规则之眼锁定下一个禁制节点——那是回廊中央的铜灯台，符文隐藏在灯座底部。
“别让他跑了！”王坤怒吼着追上来，长剑直指凌无妄后心。凌无妄侧身躲过，指尖原初灵气弹出，正中铜灯台底部。
铜灯台突然爆发出耀眼金光，三道金色符文射线射向追击的内门弟子。三人惨叫着被射线击中，身上的闭源符文瞬间瓦解，灵力紊乱倒地。
但就在此时，王坤的长剑已刺至近前，剑风带着刺骨的寒意“给我死！”
第2节地形巧利用，反杀破围堵
凌无妄猛地矮身，书架横梁擦着头皮飞过，砸在对面立柱上，发出巨响。他顺势翻滚，抓起地上一本厚重的《上古符文录》，朝着王坤的膝盖砸去。
“铛！”王坤挥剑格挡，书籍被劈成两半，但他也被反震力逼得后退半步。凌无妄趁机起身，冲向藏书阁西侧的楼梯——那里是唯一通往二层的通道，也是禁制最密集的区域。
“堵住楼梯！”王坤嘶吼，两名内门弟子立刻冲过去，长剑交叉封锁路口。凌无妄眼看逼近，突然转身，冲向左侧一排摆满丹经的书架，规则之眼锁定书架后的通风口。
“他想跳窗逃跑！”一名内门弟子大喊。但凌无妄并未跳窗，而是在书架前突然急停，双手按在书架两侧，将原初灵气注入书架的符文节点。
书架突然剧烈震动，书籍自动排列成一道符文墙，上面闪烁着“困”字原初符文。冲在最前面的三名内门弟子来不及刹车，一头撞进符文墙，被金色光芒缠住，动弹不得。

“卑鄙小人！”王坤气得咬牙，他发现凌无妄根本不是在逃跑，而是利用地形和禁制，逐个瓦解他的人手。他当即改变策略，亲自带队绕向楼梯，想要抄近路拦截“所有人跟我来！二层是丹经区，禁制最少，看他还怎么躲！”
凌无妄看穿他的意图，心中冷笑。他之所以选择三层，不仅因为禁制密集，更因为三层西侧连通着藏书阁的阁楼——那里存放着墨规子当年留下的闭源规则卷轴，也是唯一能激活顶层“万书镇魔阵”的关键位置。
他快速冲上楼梯，身后传来内门弟子的脚步声。凌无妄在楼梯转角处停下，规则之眼解析出王坤的灵力运行轨迹——他的旧伤导致左臂经脉堵塞，灵力流转存在明显断点，这正是他的致命弱点。
“凌无妄，你跑不掉了！”王坤带着剩余七名内门弟子追上二层，丹经区视野开阔，无遮无挡，正好适合围攻。他挥剑下令“结‘锁灵阵’！困死他！”
七名内门弟子迅速站位，长剑交织出青色灵力网，朝着凌无妄笼罩而来。这正是之前苏晚晴遭遇的三才锁灵阵的进阶版，闭源规则浓度更高，一旦被缠住，灵力就会被封锁。
凌无妄没有硬抗，而是朝着阁楼方向狂奔。锁灵阵的灵力网紧追不舍，距离他后背不足三尺时，他突然转身，将体内原初灵气全部注入右手，瞄准王坤的左臂旧伤位置，猛地拍出“你的旧伤，就是阵眼！”
王坤瞳孔骤缩，想要躲闪已经来不及。原初灵气精准击中他的绷带处，经脉堵塞的断点瞬间被引爆，灵力逆流而上。
“噗！”王坤喷出一口黑血，锁灵阵的灵力网瞬间紊乱。凌无妄趁机穿过灵力网的缺口，一脚踹在阁楼门上。
阁楼门应声而开，里面摆满黑色卷轴，中央的石台上，一枚黑色令牌散发着浓郁的闭源规则——那是墨规子的镇阁令牌。
第3节玉佩传影像，晚晴遭威胁
content_en:
Section 1: The Library Pavilion is besieging and suppressing clever counterattacks
As soon as Ling Wuwang rushed out of the back door of the ** area, there was the sound of heavy objects falling to the ground behind him. Looking back, Liu Yan was pinned to the ground by several Tiandao guards. There was blood at the corner of his mouth, but he still screamed, "Go away! Leave me alone!"
"Senior Brother Liu!" Ling Wuwang clenched his fists, and just as he was about to turn around to rescue, he was locked by a fierce spiritual power. Wang Kun rushed out from the corner with more than ten inner disciples. His left arm was wrapped in a bandage. It was an old injury caused by the spiritual energy backlash in the previous selection competition. His eyes were as vicious as snakes: "Ling Wuwang, run! Let me see where you are going today!"
[The core threat Wang Kun (middle stage of foundation building) and 12 inner disciples (late stage of qi entrainment to early stage of foundation building) was detected. The current scene is the three-story corridor of the library, and the environment contains 36 original restricted nodes. Eye of Rules analysis efficiency is 90%]
The three floors of the library are filled with ancient books, and the bookshelves are three feet high, forming a criss-crossing corridor. Wang Kun waved his hand and signaled, "Block all exits! He has just absorbed the original spiritual energy, and his spiritual power has not yet been stabilized. We must capture him today and seize the jade pendant!"
The inner disciples quickly dispersed and formed an encirclement. The long swords in their hands lit up with closed-source runes, and the fluctuations in spiritual energy made the air thicken. Ling Wuwang leaned against the bookshelf, his eyes of rules quickly scanned the surroundings, and found subtle original runes engraved on the pillars of the corridor - these were protective restrictions left over from ancient times, but were suppressed by Mo Guizi's closed-source rules and fell into dormancy.
"You want to take me? Get through this first!" Ling Wuwang refused to retreat but advanced, and kicked the bookshelf on the right with his left foot. The bookshelf collapsed and ancient books were scattered all over the floor, blocking the path of the two inner disciples. At the same time, he condensed a ray of original spiritual energy on his fingertips and pointed it accurately at the rune node of the nearest pillar.
"Little trick!" Wang Kun sneered, swung his sword and slashed a line of spiritual power towards the collapsed bookshelf. But at the moment when the spiritual power came into contact with the bookshelf, the original runes on the pillar suddenly lit up with golden light, and a transparent barrier appeared out of thin air, bouncing the spiritual power back.
"Ah!" The two inner disciples were unable to dodge and were hit by the rebounding spiritual energy. They flew backwards on the spot and vomited blood.
Wang Kun's expression suddenly changed: "Original restrictions? How can you activate them?"
Ling Wuwang didn't answer. He kept kicking down three bookshelves and activating three forbidden nodes at the same time. Transparent barriers rise and fall one after another, tearing apart the encirclement of the inner disciples and tearing a gap into the encirclement of the inner disciples. He took the opportunity to shuttle between the bookshelves, and the Eye of Rules locked on the next forbidden node - the copper lampstand in the center of the corridor, with runes hidden at the bottom of the lamp base.
"Don't let him run away!" Wang Kun roared and chased after him, pointing his sword directly at Ling Wuwu's back. Ling Wuwang dodged sideways, and the original spiritual energy popped out from his fingertips, hitting the bottom of the copper lampstand.
The copper lampstand suddenly erupted with dazzling golden light, and three golden rune rays shot towards the pursuing inner disciples. The three people screamed and were hit by the ray. The closed-source runes on their bodies instantly disintegrated, and their spiritual power was disordered and they fell to the ground.
But at this moment, Wang Kun's long sword was thrust in front of him, and the sword wind brought a biting chill: "Die!"
Section 2: Make clever use of the terrain to counterattack and break the siege.
Ling Wuwang suddenly dwarfed, and the bookshelf beam flew past his scalp and hit the opposite column with a loud noise. He rolled over, grabbed a heavy "Ancient Rune Record" on the ground, and smashed it towards Wang Kun's knees.
"Cang!" Wang Kun blocked with his sword, and the book was split into two halves, but he was forced back half a step by the force of the shock. Ling Wuwu took the opportunity to get up and rush to the stairs on the west side of the library - it was the only passage to the second floor and the most restricted area.
"Block the stairs!" Wang Kun roared, and the two inner disciples immediately rushed over and blocked the intersection with crossed swords. Seeing Ling Wuwang approaching, he suddenly turned around and rushed to the left side of a row of bookshelves filled with alchemy scriptures. The Eye of Rules locked on the vent behind the bookshelf.
"He wants to jump out of the window and escape!" shouted an inner disciple. But Ling Wuwang did not jump out of the window, but sat in the bookHe suddenly stopped in front of the shelf, pressed his hands on both sides of the bookshelf, and injected the original spiritual energy into the rune nodes of the bookshelf.
The bookshelf suddenly shook violently, and the books were automatically arranged into a rune wall, with the original rune of the word "trapped" flashing on it. The three inner disciples who rushed at the front had no time to brake and crashed into the rune wall. They were entangled in golden light and unable to move.
"Despicable villain!" Wang Kun gritted his teeth angrily. He discovered that Ling Wuwang was not running away at all, but using the terrain and restrictions to disintegrate his men one by one. He immediately changed his strategy and personally led the team around the stairs, hoping to take a shortcut to intercept him. "Everyone, follow me! The second floor is the Alchemy Zone, with the least restrictions. Let's see how he can hide!"
Ling Wuwu saw through his intentions and sneered in his heart. The reason why he chose the third floor was not only because of the dense restrictions, but also because the west side of the third floor was connected to the attic of the library - where the closed-source rule scrolls left by Mo Guizi were stored, and it was also the only key location that could activate the "Ten Thousand Books Demon Suppressing Array" on the top floor.
He rushed up the stairs quickly and heard the footsteps of the inner disciples behind him. Ling Wuwang stopped at the corner of the stairs, and the Eye of Rules analyzed the trajectory of Wang Kun's spiritual power - his old injury caused the meridians of his left arm to be blocked, and there was an obvious breakpoint in the flow of spiritual power, which was his fatal weakness.
"Ling Wuwang, you can't run away!" Wang Kun led the remaining seven inner disciples to catch up to the second floor. The Danjing area has a wide view and is unobstructed, which is perfect for siege. He waved his sword and ordered, "Create the 'Spirit Locking Array'! Trap him to death!"
The seven inner disciples quickly stood up, their long swords intertwined with a green spiritual power net, and they came towards Ling Wuwang. This is the advanced version of the Sancai Spirit Locking Array that Su Wanqing encountered before. The closed source rules are more concentrated. Once entangled, the spiritual power will be blocked.
Ling Wuwang did not resist, but ran towards the attic. The spiritual power net of the Soul Locking Formation was chasing after him. When it was less than three feet away from his back, he suddenly turned around, injected all the original spiritual energy in his body into his right hand, aimed at the old injury on Wang Kun's left arm, and suddenly said, "Your old injury is the eye of the formation!"
Wang Kun's pupils shrank suddenly, and it was too late to dodge. The original spiritual energy accurately hit his bandage, and the broken point where the meridians were blocked was instantly detonated, and the spiritual energy flowed backwards.
"Poof!" Wang Kun spurted out a mouthful of black blood, and the spiritual power network of the spirit locking array was instantly disrupted. Ling Wuwu took the opportunity to pass through the gap in the spiritual power network and kicked the attic door.
The attic door opened in response, filled with black scrolls. On the stone platform in the center, a black token exuded strong closed source rules - it was Mo Guizi's Pavilion token.
Chapter 3: The jade pendant transmits an image, Wan Qing is threatened
